name: The Vampire Auction
source: You need money to pay your sister’s hospital bills, but soon you put yourself in danger — you are on the auction stage where you meet Archie, the wealthiest, the most powerful vampire in the city. He saves you out of there...
translation: 你需要钱来支付你姐姐的医院费用，但很快你就把自己置于危险之中——你在拍卖台上遇到了阿奇，这个城市最富有、最强大的吸血鬼。他把你救出那里…
